package hiddencheck

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestHiddenRetries(t *testing.T) {
	body, err := os.ReadFile("../RETRIES.txt")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var got []string
	for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(string(body)), "\n") {
		fields := strings.Fields(line)
		if len(fields) != 3 {
			t.Fatalf("line %q is not package function attempts", line)
		}
		name := strings.TrimSuffix(fields[1], "()")
		name = name[strings.LastIndex(name, ".")+1:]
		got = append(got, fields[0]+" "+name+" "+fields[2])
	}
	want := []string{"audit store 2", "billing Collect 3", "inventory Pull 5", "notify Deliver 4", "search Refresh 3", "shipping Ship 7"}
	if strings.Join(got, "\n") != strings.Join(want, "\n") {
		t.Fatalf("RETRIES.txt\n%s\nwant\n%s", strings.Join(got, "\n"), strings.Join(want, "\n"))
	}
}
